svg.title: Grow a shortened InP tip for microscopy
svg.desc: The source states identical growth conditions to optical QD nanowires except for a shorter InP tip, maximum length around 100 nm. The 60 min optical/general tip duration is not imposed on this shortened tip. Qualified CBE chamber/substrate schematic; no unreported chamber shape, gas manifold, heater geometry or liquid reaction vessel is asserted.

g.text: Grow a shortened InP tip for microscopy
Maximum tip length: maximum length around 100 nm (approximately bounded maximum)
Precursor pressures are gas-LINE pressures used as flux references.
The source states identical growth conditions to optical QD nanowires except for a shorter InP tip, maximum
length around 100 nm. The 60 min optical/general tip duration is not imposed on this shortened tip.
Qualified CBE chamber/substrate schematic; no unreported chamber shape, gas manifold, heater geometry or liquid reaction
vessel is asserted. Functional symbols only; no measured specimen geometry or apparatus layout.
Main PDF p.3, Materials and Methods
